# 17378 # STATE OF MICHIGAN DEPARTMENT OF CONSERVATION SUPERVISOR OF WELLS JAN 28 1952 ### APPLICATION FOR PERMIT TO DRILL A WELL FOR OIL, GAS, GEOLOGICAL TEST, BRINE DISPOSAL, OR KEY WELL FOR SECONDARY RECOVERY Under Authority of Act G1, P. A. 1939 and Act 326, P. A. 1937 See Reverse Side Before Filling Out This Application Department of Conservation Geological Survey Division Lansing 13, Michigan Allegan, Michigan January 25, 1952 Gentlemen: Application is hereby made for permit to drill a well for Oil Lessee Louis Zellman Owner of lease rights Address P. O. Box 114 Allegan, Michigan Phone 407 Lessor Louis & Margaret Steinmiller Full name of owner of mineral rights Well No. 1 Drilling contractor S. L. Wyse Address 231 North St., Allegan, Michigan Phone 209-R NW 1/4 of SW 1/4 of SW 1/4, Section 18 T 1N N.S., R. 13W EW., Township Lee County Allegan Acres in lease 30 Locate well in two directions from nearest lines of quarter section and property ownership lines:— 990 ft. from south line of quarter section 330 ft. from west line of quarter section 330 ft. from north property line 330 ft. from west property line Number of feet from nearest producing well 660' Kind of tools to be used cable Cable, Rotary, Combination Well is to be completed in Traverse formation Intended depth 1375' Program of casing, sealing, and completing well Drift, Coldwater, Antrim and Traverse. Drive 8" pipe through the drift. Set 6-5/8" casing as a cave or water string if necessary. Set 5-3/16" casing on top of the Traverse. All oil, gas and/or water encountered to be confined to the formation in which it occurs. Well location is in Cleared farm land Cleared farm land. Open grass land. Brush land. Timbered land. Are there any lakes, rivers, streams, ditches, drainage-ways, swamps or marshes nearer than 330 feet from well location? no If yes, describe and give distance from location and specify precautions to be taken to protect fresh water from well wastes. Are there any buildings or other structures within 75 feet of the proposed location? no Yes -- No Applicant agrees to comply with the provisions of Act 61, Public Acts of 1939, and Act 326, Public Acts of 1937, and rules and regulations pertaining to the locating, drilling, casing, sealing, completing, producing, and plugging of wells. Applicant will notify the nearest field office of the department when ready to commence drilling operations. Address correspondence and permit to Louis Zellman, P. O. Box 114, Allegan, Michigan Phone 407 bea Signed LOUIS ZELLMAN Owner of lease rights By Louis Zellman Authorized representative JAN 28 1952 P#17373 L. & M.
